name: phlix-windows
description: Phlix Media Server Client for Windows

scripts.build: npm run build:vite && npm run build:electron

signingPosture.note: Machine-readable build-signing policy. Pinned by tests/unit/signingPosturePolicy.test.mjs; human-facing twin in docs/signing.md. Sits at package.json ROOT because electron-builder validates the build object against app-builder-lib's scheme.json, whose root (Configuration) sets additionalProperties:false — an unknown key inside build or build.win is a hard InvalidConfigurationError on every electron-builder run.
signingPosture.why: With no certificate configured, app-builder-lib's windowsSignToolManager.signFile logs 'no code signing certificate configured, signing is skipped' and returns false; winPackager._sign then throws InvalidConfigurationError ("App is not signed and 'forceCodeSigning' is set to true") — so enabling forceCodeSigning before certificates exist fails every electron-builder leg, not just signing.
signingPosture.flipGate: Set build.win.forceCodeSigning true only together with WIN-08 certificate provisioning — repo secrets AUTHENTICODE_CERT / AUTHENTICODE_CERT_PASSWORD (win leg) and APPX_SIGNING_CERT / APPX_SIGNING_CERT_PASSWORD (appx leg) — with signing on a windows-leg runner per docs/signing.md 'CI Signing Configuration', and update this block plus docs/signing.md and the law test in the same change.
